title: First 5 commissioners stepping out of votes on their own departments' money
question: Did commissioners who run City departments step out of votes that sent First 5 money to those departments?
finding: The minutes record at least 19 distinct recusals under Government Code 1090 between 2016 and 2022, mostly on budget rows for the commissioner's own department (for example the youth department's IT help desk and the health department's mental-health consultation rows). Nothing here suggests a vote was cast where a recusal was due.
how: Every minutes file was searched for the standard recusal sentence; the item approved just before it is shown. Repeated draft/final copies of the same minutes are counted once.
limits: Only recusals that were minuted are visible; a missed recusal would not appear. The minutes name commissioners by surname only, as shown.
